item.title: Secondary Window Retrofit Demonstration
item.description:
Citywide Administrative Services | Procurement | Intent to Award | Due: 2026-10-17 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Citywide Administrative Services intends to award Inouves Inc a two-year contract of up to $215,025.44 to test interior secondary window retrofits at Woodhull Hospital in Brooklyn, using a demonstration project method for innovative products.

Pursuant to Section 3-11 of the Procurement Policy Board Rules, the New York City Department of Citywide Administrative Services ('DCAS') intends to enter into a contract with Inouves Inc to utilize the Demonstration Project method for Innovative Products, Approaches or Technologies to procure testing of interior Secondary Window Retrofits (SWRs) at Health and Hospital Corporations (HHC) Woodhull Hospital, 760 Broadway, Brooklyn, NY 11206. The term of the agreement is for two years for a cost not to exceed $215,025.44. EPIN 85627D0001. This advertisement is for informational purposes only.

Any firm that believes it could also provide these requirements can be considered in future procurements conducted by the Agency. Any Expressions of Interest can be sent to juwoo@dcas.nyc.gov.

item.description:
Citywide Administrative Services | Procurement | Solicitation | Due: 2026-10-22 In plain English (machine-written): The Department of Citywide Administrative Services is seeking up to five vendors to provide real estate appraisal reports in New York City through work orders, chosen from competing proposals due Oct. 22, 2026.

The City of New York Department of Citywide Administrative Services (DCAS) is seeking up to five (5) qualified vendors (hereafter, the Vendor(s) and Contractor(s)) to perform appraisal reports of real estate in New York City, through the issuance of Work Orders. Appraiser may occasionally be required to perform appraisals outside of New York City as needed by DCAS. This solicitation is being made pursuant to the Competitive Sealed Proposal Method, Section 3-03 of the New York City Procurement Policy Board (PPB) Rules. DCAS Office of Citywide Procurement, Agency 856 will hold a virtual Pre-Proposal Conference. Please see the Address Location box in PASSPort for the link. If you are experiencing any difficulties responding to this RFx, please reach out to MOCS service desk at the following link: http://nyc.gov/mocshelp
